verdict.rationale: Quo's own call-handling features act automatically on inbound-call events: routing, custom ring orders, phone menus, and Sona answering when the team can't. That is a narrow, telephony-only form of event-triggered rules, not a general user-defined rule or workflow builder. The call-summary webhook is a developer building block, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: a general rule or automation builder with configurable triggers and actions, documentation of how rules are defined, coverage of events beyond call routing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
